description: Get the currently active intent, preferring approved intents with real objective/outcome content over empty stubs. With a workspace connected it chooses across the whole workspace, not by repository, so do not use it to find the intent for the repository you are working in: read intent.md or call check_intent_readiness with no arguments, and when the repository has none, ask which intent the user means. Returns the full IntentSpec plus an evidenceSummary (how many evidence items it cites by ID, across all trust tiers; tier counts come with include_evidence=true). Evidence is referenced by ID; pass include_evidence=true to inline the evidence content grouped by trust tier (backing, unreviewed, assumption) with per-tier counts, or call get_agent_prompt for the full evidence-backed execution prompt.

include_evidence.description: Inline the actual evidence items (truncated) this intent cites, grouped by trust tier with an evidenceTiers count. Default false — the default response carries only a fetch-free evidenceSummary to keep casual calls cheap.

status.description: Filter by status: draft, validated, approved, shipped, verified

name: get_current_intent
title: Get Current Intent
